description: Inbound calls logged in HubSpot (from RingCX) per deal owner, since Monday. Used for calls taken and close rate (policies sold ÷ inbound calls).

args.sql: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, COUNT(*) FROM CALL WHERE hs_call_direction = 'INBOUND' AND hs_timestamp >= {{w_start}} GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 200

title: Weekly inbound calls by agent
